summary: Returns TRUE if the specified column has a direct filter applied in the current filter context — either from a slicer, visual-level filter, or CALCULATE argument. Returns FALSE if the column is only cross-filtered through a relationship.
whenToUse: Use ISFILTERED to make a measure behave differently depending on whether the user has explicitly filtered on a specific column. Common in dynamic titles, conditional formatting, and measures that must be suppressed when no filter is applied.

parameters.name: columnName
parameters.description: The column to test for a direct filter. Must be a physical column — not a measure.

commonTraps: ISFILTERED detects DIRECT filters only. If a column is filtered via a relationship (cross-filter), ISFILTERED returns FALSE — use ISCROSSFILTERED for that.
ISFILTERED on a hierarchy level returns TRUE only when that specific level has a direct filter, not when parent or child levels are filtered.
ISFILTERED is evaluated inside a CALCULATE expression's filter context, so it can return different values depending on where it appears in a measure.

examples.label: Dynamic measure title
examples.expression:
Report Title =
IF(
    ISFILTERED(DimProduct[Category]),
    "Sales — " & SELECTEDVALUE(DimProduct[Category], "Multiple"),
    "Sales — All Products"
)
examples.explanation: Returns a dynamic title that shows 'All Products' when no category slicer is applied, or the selected category name when one is active.

examples.label: Suppress measure when no date selected
examples.expression:
YTD Sales (Guarded) =
IF(
    ISFILTERED(DimDate[Year]),
    TOTALYTD([Total Sales], DimDate[Date]),
    BLANK()
)
examples.explanation: Returns BLANK instead of a misleading total when the user has not explicitly filtered by year.

examples.label: ISFILTERED vs ISCROSSFILTERED comparison
examples.expression:
Filter Status =
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    ISFILTERED(DimProduct[Category]),     "Direct filter",
    ISCROSSFILTERED(DimProduct[Category]), "Cross-filter via relationship",
    "No filter"
)
examples.explanation: Shows which type of filter is active on Category — direct (slicer/filter pane) vs indirect (via a related table filter).

sqlEquivalent: No direct SQL equivalent. Closest concept: checking whether a WHERE clause contains a specific column predicate.
